expected.raw_text: deploying AI/ML models to production in the cloud
privacy-preserving machine learning, and secure AI techniques

parsed.degree_signal: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Electronics, Mathematics, or another highly technical field.
parsed.notes:
What You Bring sets required qualifications; Preferred sets optional qualifications. Responsibilities and career-growth sections do not establish additional candidate skills.
The broad machine-learning mapping for experience using ML frameworks is flagged for review; PyTorch and TensorFlow are explicit alternatives.
Production deployment in Preferred collapses into the required AI/ML deployment criterion.
Privacy-preserving machine learning and secure AI techniques map to Data Privacy & Security; model encryption is retained separately as unmapped.
Optimizing large-scale models does not explicitly specify inference optimization, and large-scale models does not necessarily mean LLMs; neither narrower skill is inferred.
The highest degree named is PhD and is preferred, although a bachelor’s degree is separately required. The related-field wording does not permit experience in place of a degree.
The general encouragement to apply without meeting every qualification does not change individual requirement labels.
